comments.text: Hi Gurleen, if we pay for 2 or 3 year premium in one shot, can we claim the 80D rebate in 2nd and 3rd year, if yes how?
comments.author: @gauravv1679

comments.text:
Yes, it can be done. You can use the same receipt every year for claiming the benefit. 

If you are paying for 2 years, then the amount claimed is divided by 2  and claimed every year for income tax benefits

If you are paying for 3 years, then the amount claimed is divided by 3 and claimed every year for income tax benefits
